protocol.primary: median depth scale shared by D+known K+predicted pose, canonical first-camera gauge; no Sim3/ICP
protocol.secondary: one global Sim3 for XYZ; separate camera-center Sim3 for ATE/RPE
protocol.point_head: absent in both adapted VGGT models; not mixed with an official point head
protocol.surface_metrics: N50 only, unsquared mean directional distances / 2; no ICP
protocol.macro: unweighted arithmetic mean of two sequence metrics per split; never mixes VAL/reserved
protocol.macro_missing_policy: Missing values are not dropped; a metric is N/D unless both sequences provide it
protocol.percentage: positive = favorable; lower/higher direction respected; changes of split means, not mean percentages
protocol.context_limit: N changes selected views and evaluation support; not a pure causal N or trajectory-length threshold experiment
protocol.timing_limit: forward_plus_output_s includes saving/hashing outputs; not treated as pure model latency
protocol.reserved_limit: Excluded from this fine-tuning; already used in prior project analyses, not a new blinded external test
protocol.GT_usage: scale/alignment for scoring and calibrated K for geometry; GT is not a neural-network input

known_validation_points.source: saved BEST diagnostic metadata; per-sequence values unavailable

training.checkpoint_primary: predeclared FINAL3000; BEST800 not substituted or evaluated as the final model

CPU_recovery.changes: Only GPU imports are omitted; exact original CPU function executes
